summary: CRITICAL RETEST of the email-verification double-fire bug (found in iteration_20). All 5 requested items PASS. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_verify_email_idempotent.py (5 tests, 5 pass) verifying the verify-email endpoint is now idempotent - token is no longer nulled on success, 1st call returns success with email, 2nd/3rd calls return success + already_verified:true, invalid token still 400, resend for verified user returns already_verified:true. Frontend: real-token load of /verify-email?token=<valid> now renders 'Email Verified Successfully' (previously 'Verification Failed'); network interception confirms exactly ONE /api/auth/verify-email request despite React StrictMode (useRef hasVerified guard works). iOS UA (iPhone 17_5 Safari) shows button text 'Return to Cycle Coach' plus the deep-link hint. Error state (invalid token) renders both data-testid buttons (error-resend-btn, error-back-login-btn) and Back-to-Log-In navigates to /login. Waiting state (no token) renders correctly with resend-verification-btn. Regression suite (test_email_verification.py + test_auth_account.py) 33/33 pass after fixing one stale test assertion. Throwaway test users cleaned up (3 deleted, 0 remaining).

If you want cleanup, null the token on a delayed/TTL basis or add a verified_at timestamp and reject tokens older than N days.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/auth.py verify-email: idempotency implemented correctly - user is looked up by verification_token, early-returns already_verified:true when email_verified is already true, and only then performs the update + welcome email. No double welcome email on repeated calls (confirmed: 2nd/3rd calls short-circuit before asyncio.create_task).

VerifyEmail.jsx: useRef hasVerified guard is set BEFORE the async verifyToken call, which is the correct ordering to survive StrictMode's synchronous double-invocation. Verified only 1 network request fires.
VerifyEmail.jsx handleResend: on the missing-email early-return path, setResending(false) is handled by the finally block - correct, no stuck spinner.

Use /app/backend/tests/get_verify_token.py <email> to mint a real verification token (it deletes the user first, registers, then prints TOKEN=...). rca_of_the_issue: ORIGINAL BUG (iteration_20): the verify-email endpoint set verification_token=None on successful verification. React StrictMode invoked the useEffect twice, firing two concurrent GET /api/auth/verify-email requests with the same token. The first succeeded and cleared the token; the second found no matching document and raised 400, so the component's last setStatus won and rendered 'Verification Failed' even though the email WAS verified. FIX VERIFIED on both layers: (1) backend retains verification_token and returns {success:true, already_verified:true} when email_verified is already set, making the endpoint idempotent; (2) frontend hasVerified useRef is flipped synchronously before the fetch, so StrictMode's second invocation is skipped entirely - network interception confirmed exactly 1 request. Both defenses independently confirmed working.
